attBesluta.text: Nice big box. I installed a 13,500 lb winch, a battery, lighting for the trailer deck, and hitch, plus it holds all of my strapping.

Overall, this is a good deal. While not top-of-the-line, it matches the quality of boxes costing far more. The latch and strut work well. I recommend adding some loctite to the latch screw internally. The weather seal doesn't do much while traveling on dusty roads; an upgrade will be needed.

El dispensador cubre zapatos es una solución práctica y eficiente para mantener la limpieza en cualquier espacio. Su uso es rápido y sencillo: en segundos coloca una funda protectora sobre el calzado sin necesidad de agacharse ni ensuciarse las manos. Es ideal tanto para hogares como para entornos profesionales (clínicas, oficinas o visitas técnicas), ya que ayuda a conservar los suelos impecables. Además, su diseño compacto y su facilidad de recarga lo convierten en un accesorio cómodo, higiénico y muy útil en el día a día.
Shoe covers are perfect to wear if you want to walk with your shoes at home and keep your house clean. Perfect when you have visitors who don't want to remove their shoes.

I like this product. It was very easy to set up and use. I bought it for my husband and son because they work on cars outside and we have red clay, and it gets very muddy where we live. It's too big of an inconvenience to take off their shoes when they need to come in and out constantly. This is a very convenient help in that it helps them not track in mud. I tried buying the snap-on ones that are like the old slap bracelets, but they were not a good size for my husband and would slide off of his shoes. These are the perfect replacements. You can buy refills if needed. It comes with a lot to begin with so they should last a while depending on who all is using them. To be honest, if they are still clean afterward, I would say you could just reuse them. I would definitely recommend them.
